responsibility: This header declares gm2’s small set of tree-debugging utilities: dumping a single tree, dumping a chained tree list, and printing the current statement list. It is the C interface companion to the lightweight inspection helpers in m2misc.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2misc group: it declares the native debugging helpers, including DebugTreeChain and printStmt in addition to DebugTree, while m2misc.def exposes only the Modula-2-facing subset and m2misc.cc implements them.
